description.fun: Zubat has no eyes or nostrils: it finds its way around dark caves by echolocation, sending out ultrasonic cries, and each colony calls at a slightly different pitch. Sunlight makes it ill and can even burn its skin, so it sleeps upside down all day and comes out at night in great swarms. Its name mixes 'bat' with the Japanese 'zubatto', 'piercingly'.
description.guide: A small, blue Poison and Flying bat Pokémon with no eyes, which finds its way using ultrasonic cries. It lives in large groups in dark caves, sleeps upside down during the day and avoids sunlight. It evolves into Golbat and then Crobat.
description.tagline: An eyeless cave bat that sees with its voice

description.fun: Golbat is mostly mouth, and its hollow fangs work like straws: it can drink 300 ml of blood in one sitting, sometimes so much that it's too heavy to fly. It's so greedy that its blood type changes to match its last meal, and some Golbat have lost fangs trying to bite Steel-type Pokémon. Still, it shares what it gathers with hungry Golbat.
description.guide: The evolution of Zubat, a large bat Pokémon with a huge mouth and hollow fangs it uses to drink blood. It is nocturnal and common in caves. It evolves into Crobat with high friendship.
description.tagline: A flying mouth with straw-like fangs

description.fun: Crobat's hind legs became a second pair of wings, so it can fly long distances by switching between the two, fast and silently enough to bite prey before it's noticed. It zips through cramped caves without slowing down, but on the ground it can only crawl. Added in Generation 2, it evolves from Golbat only once it trusts its Trainer.
description.guide: The final stage of Zubat's line, introduced in Generation 2: a purple bat Pokémon with two pairs of wings, the lower pair grown from its hind legs. It flies fast and silently but is clumsy on the ground. It evolves from Golbat with high friendship.
description.tagline: Four wings, no feet, and not a sound as it flies
